# Gate 2 package - BI-PF-1276
**Eventing SSOT: retire legacy websocket push (frozen dashboard -> SSE)**

## Plain language
**What/why:** core/websocket_manager.py duplicates the push concern in the frozen legacy dashboard and lacks unified event bus integration. -> Marks core/websocket_manager.py DEPRECATED, adds it to config/legacy-frozen.json with sha256 hash, and provides contract tests.

## Gate 0 reconciliation + impact
RECONCILIATION - BI-PF-1276
  prior_decisions : ['docs/EVENTING-ALERTING-SSOT-DESIGN.md:103,139 - legacy WebSocket transport retired when superseded by SSE and left frozen.', 'ADR-0001 / ADR-0007 / ADR-0008: Go-first for new shipped work; Python edits minimal and compliant with language rule.', 'BI-PF-1265: Eventing SSOT Epic umbrella architecture.', 'BI-PF-1274: Server-Sent Events /api/v1/events/stream established as canonical real-time push mechanism.']
  existing_path   : ['core/websocket_manager.py:25: Legacy WebSocketManager and websocket_endpoint.', 'config/legacy-frozen.json:1: Registry of frozen legacy files enforced by wired_audit.legacy_guard.', 'api/routers/events.py:27: SSE stream route GET /api/v1/events/stream.']
  assumptions     : ['core/websocket_manager.py must be retained (never deleted) until the legacy dashboard is fully decommissioned.', 'Zero active runtime components outside legacy dashboard rely on websocket_manager.']
  divergences     : ['None; fully aligns with docs/EVENTING-ALERTING-SSOT-DESIGN.md §5 consumer migration matrix retiring WebSocket in favor of SSE.']
  open_questions  : []
IMPACT REVIEW
  claim | verdict | evidence | recommendation
  Retire legacy websocket_manager in favor of Eventing SSOT SSE | aligned | docs/EVENTING-ALERTING-SSOT-DESIGN.md:103 | Add deprecation notice and document SSE stream migration path.
  Freeze core/websocket_manager.py in config/legacy-frozen.json | aligned | config/legacy-frozen.json:1-12 | Register websocket_manager with sha256 to prevent further extension.
  API CHECK: deprecate ws without introducing new HTTP routes | aligned | api/routers/events.py:27 | needs_api=false; SSE route /api/v1/events/stream is already live and serves real-time events.
  LANGUAGE RULE: deprecation edit on existing shipped Python | aligned | scripts/dev/language_rule_review.py:120 | Small comment/docstring edit on existing Python (< 30 lines); language-rule: OK.
  AC: 5 detailed acceptance criteria verifying WS retirement | aligned | engineering/design/BI-PF-1276.md | Verify via dedicated test suite in test-framework/tests/pipeline/test_events_retire_ws_api.py.
